tools.description: Run a JavaScript regex across every scan we've ever taken. Returns matching site URLs (and optional snippets). Best for ad-hoc discovery of patterns NOT already extracted into id_index. Pass narrowing filters (vendor, tld, since) to keep scan volume manageable. Default returns URLs only — set with_snippets=true if you also want the matched JSON context.

all.description: Scan ALL shards — entire corpus. May exceed Worker CPU budget for complex regex; use only when you've narrowed via vendor/tld.

domain_like.description: Substring to match in domain, e.g. 'patagonia'

limit.description: Max matching sites to return (default 200, max 2000)

max_scan.description: Max R2 objects to read for this query (default 10000, max 200000)

max_shards.description: Cap how many shards to query (newest-first). Default 100, raise to scan deeper history. Each shard ≈ 800 scans.

since.description: Only scans >= this date, format YYYY-MM-DD

tld.description: Restrict to this TLD, e.g. 'com.au' or 'co.uk'

vendor.description: Pre-narrow via id_index to sites known to use this vendor (e.g. 'shopify')

with_snippets.description: Include matched JSON context. Default false (URLs only).

tools.name: grep_pattern

tools.description: Same as grep_pattern but returns only the count of matching sites. Faster — no per-match serialization. Useful for sizing 'how many sites use X' before doing a full grep.
tools.name: count_pattern

tools.description: Return sites that have a known signal_type=signal_value pair in id_index. MUCH faster than grep_pattern — uses pre-indexed D1 lookup. Use this whenever the signal_type is in the list (see instructions). Examples: sites_with_signal(signal_type='vendor', signal_value='mparticle_workspace') ← won't work, that's an ID type, use sites_with_signal(signal_type='mparticle_workspace') WITHOUT signal_value to list all values + their domains.

signal_type.description: One of the known signal_type values (see instructions)

signal_value.description: Optional exact value to filter to. If omitted, returns all domains for any value of this signal_type.

tools.name: sites_with_signal

tools.description: Returns the full catalog of signal_types currently present in id_index, with counts of unique values and unique domains for each.
tools.name: list_signal_types
